priorTrials.rationale: Target lapsed users with a 5% discount to re-engage them, using a 14-day gap and minRecency to avoid spamming recent buyers. Price ratio 2 ensures affordability.
Target users with recent intent signals frequently (7 days) without discounts, focusing heavily on intent and value to maximize platform contribution.

method.backbone: Gemini 3.1 Pro MEDIUM for every LLM role and single-agent call
method.design: Three construction sessions, two observed development markets each. Independent recommendation and campaign specialists propose two candidates each; coordinator sees four measured trials and proposes one. Single agent gets sequential 2+2+1 candidates and the same three calls. Numerical search evaluates five predefined diverse configurations in the same representation. Fixed winner and no campaign are shared fallbacks.
method.selection: Choose among five proposals plus common fixed/no-campaign fallbacks by validation mean settled platform contribution, requiring validation mean merchant contribution >= fixed. Validation scores withheld from model calls. Held-out markets are opened only after all policies and selections are frozen.
method.ranking: Day30 snapshot evaluated against days31-37 no-campaign future purchases; canonical SKU Recall@3 and NDCG@3, plus merchant-offer Recall@3. Count-affinity and popularity controls share canonical mapping. No future labels in model fit.
method.economics: Paired same seeds, 30-day shared warmup, 60 contact days, 100 total shopping days plus14 return tail. Exact offered-item purchase attribution. Frozen wallet, fatigue, returns, fees, subsidy and outreach assumptions. Report each full construction cost and subtract it once per design block, evenly across its four test markets; also show conservative full-cost-per-market results.
method.primary: Paired net modeled platform contribution versus fixed, numerical search and matched single agent. Also merchant contribution, recommendation-attributed orders, total orders, retained volume, coupon redemption, ranking, diversity, validation failures, latency and token cost.
method.limits: Three design sessions and twelve synthetic markets are a pilot, not production profit or proof of general multi-agent superiority. Markets within a design block share a learned policy. No native PayPal calls or external catalog calls.
method.amendment: Before any model call or held-out evaluation: changed numeric schema enums to bounded numeric fields with runtime exact-set validation for Vertex compatibility.

disclosure: Synthetic markets, authored products and modeled payment economics. Three fresh construction sessions per LLM arm; policies are reused across four unseen markets per session. No new PayPal captures. Token-metered list-price estimates, not a billing invoice.
